# MicroCommander

> MicroCommander is "Salamander for Mac" (Czech: "Salamander pro Mac"): a free, open-source dual-pane file manager for macOS 13+ that works like Altap Salamander on Windows. It is an independent rewrite (port) of Open Salamander, the GPL-licensed open-source version of Altap Salamander, with a Rust core and a native Swift/AppKit UI. It is not an official Altap product and is not affiliated with Altap.

Key facts:

- Two panels with Salamander-style controls: F3 view, F4 edit, F5 copy, F6 move, F7 new folder, F8 delete; Ctrl shortcuts also work with ⌘; every shortcut can be remapped.
- FTP and SFTP (password, ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key, ssh-agent; passwords in the macOS Keychain).
- ZIP, TAR and TAR.GZ open like folders (read-only); ZIP creation with AES-256 or ZipCrypto encryption.
- Search with Salamander-style masks and content search (text, HEX, regular expressions), optionally inside archives.
- Built-in terminal, Quick Look, drag and drop with Finder, Czech and English UI, color schemes (Open Salamander, Norton Commander, DOS Navigator…).
- Not supported yet: plugins, 7z, RAR, FTPS. No prebuilt binary yet: it is built from source with `make run` (needs Xcode Command Line Tools and Rust).
- License: GPL-2.0-or-later. Price: free, no ads, no telemetry.

## Source code

- [GitHub repository svopex/MicroCommander](https://github.com/svopex/MicroCommander): source code, issues and the full README with all keyboard shortcuts and limitations
- [Open Salamander](https://github.com/OpenSalamander/salamander): the open-source Windows file manager MicroCommander is based on
